observations: J-DOPPS III/IV observational cohort included 2,606 Japanese adults receiving hemodialysis; ferritin categories were <50, 50–99.9, 100–199.9, and ≥200 ng/mL.
In patients with CRP <0.3 mg/dL, adjusted all-cause mortality showed a U-shaped relationship across ferritin categories; this pattern was not significant in the higher-CRP subgroup.
Albumin stratification at 3.8 g/dL yielded similar findings; retrieved abstract-level evidence did not provide category-specific adjusted hazard ratios.
